        xs_reset_transport(transport)
        sock = xs_create_sock(xprt, transport, xs_addr(xprt).sa_family, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP, True)
        if IS_ERR(sock):

    trace_rpc_socket_connect(xprt, sock, status)

    if status == 0 or status == -EINPROGRESS:

        if xprt.reestablish_timeout < XS_TCP_INIT_REEST_TO:
            xprt.reestablish_timeout = XS_TCP_INIT_REEST_TO
        status = -EAGAIN

    elif status == -EALREADY:
        status = -EAGAIN

        pass
